short_bio: Portuguese footballer, five-time Ballon d’Or winner and the all-time leading scorer in men’s international football.
biography:
Cristiano Ronaldo was born in Funchal on the island of Madeira and started at Sporting CP before joining Manchester United in 2003. He won the Champions League with United in 2008 and the Ballon d’Or that year.

He moved to Real Madrid in 2009 and won four more Champions League titles, in 2014, 2016, 2017 and 2018, before joining Juventus (2018–2021). He returned to Manchester United in 2021 and joined Al Nassr in Saudi Arabia in 2023.

With Portugal he won the European Championship in 2016 and the UEFA Nations League in 2019. He holds the men’s record for international goals.
